verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਂਚੋ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਖਟ ਭੇਦਿ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੇ ਕਹਾਏ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਬੇਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: paa(n)cho mu(n)dhraa chakr khaT bhedh chakrave kahaae ula(n)gh tirabenee tirakuTee tirakaal jaane hai ||

en.bdb: By the perpetual practice of Naam Simran, a Guru-conscious person discards the five ear-rings and six stages of spiritual planes of the Yogi and is known as a an emperor. He crosses the stages of Tribeni and Trikuti and becomes aware of the happenings in the three periods.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਘਰ ਜੀਤਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਮੈ ਨਗਰ ਅਗਮ ਪੁਰ ਜਾਇ ਠਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: nav ghar jeet nij aasan si(n)ghaasan mai nagar agam pur jai Thahiraane hai ||

en.bdb: Controlling all the nine sensual organs he reaches the tenth gate-the throne of highest spiritual realm. The place that is difficult to reach, he reaches there very conveniently.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਸਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਹੰਸ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਬਿਸਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aan sar tiaag maanasar nihachal ha(n)s param nidhaan bisamaeh bisamaane hai ||

en.bdb: Such a Guru-conscious swan-like disciple gives up company of the self-willed people and resides in the Mansarover lake-like congregation of holy persons. He practices the Naam like treasure there and achieves marvellous and astonishing spiritual state.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਗਗਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੪੭॥
verses.translit_en: aunaman magan gagan anahadh dhun baajat neesaan giaan dhiaan bisaraane hai ||247||

en.bdb: He thus gets absorbed in the highest spiritual state. He listens to such melodious tunes in his tenth door that he forgets and discards all other worldly interests. (247)
